gloss: to receive payment; for money to arrive

definitions.gloss: to receive payment; for money to arrive; for funds to be deposited
definitions.explanation: For money to arrive at a bank account or reach the intended recipient. Describes the event from the receiver's perspective.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}が{着金|ちゃっきん}した。
{振込|ふりこみ}は{翌営業日|よくえいぎょうび}に{着金|ちゃっきん}する{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: The transfer is scheduled to arrive on the next business day.

examples.japanese: まだ{着金|ちゃっきん}が{確認|かくにん}できていないので、{銀行|ぎんこう}に{問|と}い{合|あ}わせてみます。
examples.english: I haven't been able to confirm receipt of the funds yet, so I'll check with the bank.

notes:
A する verb composed of {着|ちゃく} (arrive) + {金|きん} (money). Used in business and banking contexts for money arriving at its destination.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着金|ちゃっきん}を{確認|かくにん}する: to confirm receipt of funds
- {着金|ちゃっきん}{予定日|よていび}: expected date of fund arrival
- {着金|ちゃっきん}{通知|つうち}: payment arrival notification
- {着金|ちゃっきん}が{遅|おく}れる: for the payment to be delayed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入金|にゅうきん}する: to deposit/receive money — more general; can also mean to pay money in
- {振|ふ}り{込|こ}む: to transfer money — describes the sender's action, not the arrival
- {送金|そうきん}する: to remit money — the act of sending money
